newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Cumnock sees 9.6 pct of shares traded.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Cumnock sees 9.6 pct of shares traded.

text.p: A single trade of three million shares shot coal miner Cumnock Coal Ltd to the top of the turnover lists early on Friday.
The trade, about 9.6 percent of Cumnock's capital, was specialled through County Natwest at a price of A$2.40 per share.
A Cumnock Coal spokesman said the company was unaware of the identity of the buyers or sellers at this stage.
Swiss-metals house Glencore AG holds a 25.14 percent stake in Cumnock, while CIM Resources Ltd holds a 5.01 percent stake.
A Glencore spokesman told Reuters Glencore was not involved on either side of the trade.
"Definitely not," said Glencore's coal division head, Mark Lochtenberg.
A CIM Resources company spokesman also denied any involvement in the trade.
CIM said in September it was losing interest in a Cumnock partnership or acquisition due to Glencore's attitude.
By 11.20 a.m. (0020 GMT), Cumnock shares were 12 cents higher at A$2.42 on turnover of 3.01 million shares.
